g1.label: 1. Cuts and styles hair
g1.why: A hairdresser's job is cutting and styling people's hair.

g2.label: 2. Builds things out of wood
g2.why: A carpenter makes furniture, doors and other things from wood.

g3.label: 3. Repairs or builds machines
g3.why: A mechanic works with machines and engines, for example in cars.

g4.label: 4. Cooks food in a restaurant
g4.why: A chef is a professional cook in a restaurant or hotel.

g5.label: 5. Helps sick people in hospital
g5.why: A nurse looks after sick or injured people, usually in a hospital.

g6.label: 6. Repairs pipes in buildings
g6.why: A plumber fits and repairs water pipes, taps and toilets.

g7.label: 7. Books holidays and flights
g7.why: A travel agent arranges holidays, flights and hotels for customers.

g8.label: 8. Works with patients who have injuries
g8.why: A physiotherapist treats injuries with exercise and movement.

g9.label: 9. Uses games, music and art with young children
g9.why: A preschool teacher teaches very young children, often through games, music and art.

g10.label: 10. Installs and repairs electrical systems
g10.why: An electrician works with wiring and electrical systems.

g1.label: 1. Lists your education and experience
g1.why: A CV is a document listing your education, skills and work experience.

g2.label: 2. A letter of ___
g2.why: When you apply for a job you write a 'letter of application'.

g3.label: 3. Welcomes guests at the hotel desk
g3.why: The receptionist works at the front desk and welcomes guests.

g4.label: 4. Always on time
g4.why: Punctual means always arriving on time.

g5.label: 5. People who say good things about you
g5.why: References are former employers or teachers who recommend you.

g6.label: 6. A job for a short time only
g6.why: Temporary means for a limited time; permanent means with no end date.

g7.label: 7. Guests from different ___
g7.why: The ad and Amy's email talk about dealing with guests from different cultures.

g8.label: 8. The money you earn each month
g8.why: Your salary is the regular pay you get for your job.
